What a great privilege to have you unexpectedly grace my humble domain.|[[Ghorin]] welcomes [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to his castle|audio=Ghorin01.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: Imperial Pursuit">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: Imperial Pursuit]]''</ref>}}
This '''castle''', located on [[Plooriod III]], was the residence of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Overlord (Imperial)|Overlord]] [[Ghorin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Behind the scenes==
Ghorin's residence was created for ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Tour of Duty: Imperial Pursuit]]'', the first expansion pack to the [[1993]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] and identified as a castle in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]]. ''The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia'' had an entry for Ghorin which refers to his castle on [[Plooriod IV]]. This contradicts the ''Imperial Pursuit'' cut scene, which shows the castle on Plooriod III.
